apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.subtitle: Programmatic access tokens for the UTMStack API.
apiKeys.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or allowed IP…
apiKeys.noSearchMatch: No API keys match your search.
apiKeys.empty: No API keys yet. Create one to get started.

enterprise.title: API keys are an Enterprise feature
enterprise.body: Issue, scope and rotate API keys for programmatic access to the UTMStack API. This capability is available on the Enterprise edition.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.allowedIpsHint: Comma-separated. Leave empty to allow any IP.
dialog.expiresHint: Leave empty for a key that never expires.
dialog.secretNote: The secret token is shown once, right after creation. Copy it then — it can’t be retrieved later (only rotated).

confirm.deleteBody: Delete {{name}}? Any client using it will immediately lose access. This cannot be undone.
confirm.rotateBody: Rotate {{name}}? A new secret is issued and the current one stops working immediately. The new token is shown once.

reveal.title: API key created
reveal.note: Copy this secret now — for {{name}}. It won’t be shown again. If you lose it, rotate the key.

toast.secretIssueFailed: Key created, but the secret could not be issued. Use Rotate to get one.

error.nameTaken: An API key with that name already exists
error.enterpriseRequired: API keys require the Enterprise edition
